svg.text: MAIN SECTION (drawn once, at the layout line)
panel depth D, I3 to I5
1. Benches not shown; Contractor responsible for slope stability during construction.
2. Bearing: BP for each DH on the design tables (E), factored Strength I, RL = 0.7 DH; geotech resistance ≥ BP.
3. Reinforcement: MSE extensible or inextensible per the design tables; top two layers 2.0 × RL, strength per table R;
GRS: woven geotextile at every course per the GRS reinforcing schedule.
4. MRS (SY/LF) on the design tables is for information; Contractor provides actual types, spacing and coverage.
5. Pay limits: Class 1 to top of DH, excavation limits and face; benching (203.06) included; MRS paid by volume.
6. Barrier required within the clear zone (M-606-15 Style CD). 7. Check superelevation for the geomembrane.
8. Design values: design-basis sheet B-504-A C.
OPTION TABLES: FACING AND TOP OF WALL
TABLE: QUANTITIES PER FOOT OF WALL (B-504-Q7)
RL = 0.7 DH (6, 7, 8 ft minimum); MRS = DH RL / 27; BM1, PLG per Q7.
Full table, 58 rows (DH 2 to 40 ft, 8 in steps), in the pilot file.
Seals, designer, detailer, checker, dates (standard block)
